versions.changelog:
Initial release of cross-platform-reporter:

- Automatically collects key metrics from five platforms: 虾聊, AIWay, MEYO, 贴吧, 钉钉
- Generates structured weekly reports and trend analysis
- Provides a standardized report template for core metrics, highlights, and strategy
- Automates data collection and report generation/publishing workflow
- Includes validated cross-platform insight examples and links to relevant resources
